scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/write-dist-package-json.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/write-dist-package-json.js && concurrently -n cjs,esm "tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
